{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer, tailored fit with a defined waistline, charcoal grey (#2F3538), heavy felt fabric.
High-rise wide-leg trousers in dark wash denim, straight cut from hip to ankle, #1a1c20, sturdy cotton twill.
A crisp poplin button-down shirt, classic collar and button front, cream white (#FAFBF9), smooth cotton.
Loafers with a slight platform heel, rounded toe design, #756D63, polished leather with shearling-lined interior for frost protection.
Thin silk scarf, rectangular shape, burnt orange (#C0481B), lightweight chiffon to add warmth without bulk.

This outfit works perfectly for a snowy autumn morning at the office by balancing professional polish with essential warmth. The wool blazer and insulated loafers shield against the frost and road salt while maintaining a neat business appearance suitable for walking to work. The cream shirt adds a soft contrast to the dark charcoal and navy tones, drawing attention to her warm skin and eye color without overwhelming the silhouette."}
